title: Awesome Theorems canonical catalog record v2
description: A lossless, status-separated record for an ATO source occurrence, ATF family, ATS sense, or ATV exact scoped variant. Missing evidence is represented explicitly; this schema never asks a migration worker to invent a citation.

record_id.description: Typed, append-only registry identifier; record-specific schemas additionally constrain the exact prefix.

value.description: Earliest honest ISO-like precision: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.

locator_detail.description: Page, theorem, section, declaration, data-release table, or other exact locator.

allocation_basis.description: The ID does not encode discipline, current status, kind, or a mutable text hash.

answer_polarity.description: A proved negative solution is still a proved claim; it is not a refuted claim.

license.description: A license and redistribution decision independent of bibliographic provenance. Unknown is an honest state and cannot authorize benchmark derivation.

oneOf.description: An SPDX license expression; downstream release validation performs full SPDX grammar and identifier checks.

status.description: This is record-level eligibility, never evidence that a benchmark task or release exists.
